versions.changelog: MiroFish swarm intelligence integration — combine autonomous optimization loops with multi-agent prediction simulations.
Added wizard mode (--wizard), 3 pre-built demos (--demo outreach/prediction/prompt), OpenClaw integration guide, full setup docs. Zero-friction onboarding — results in under 5 minutes.

- Initial release of auto-optimizer skill.
- Guides users through optimizing any artifact using iterative self-improvement loops.
- Supports two modes: binary evaluation (for copy/prompts/UX) and scalar evaluation (for code/metrics).
- Automates eval-mutate-select cycles to drive measurable improvements.
- Includes guidance for setting up eval criteria and building automated quality loops.
- Triggers for a wide variety of optimization and self-improvement requests.
